labelling_order: roots sorted by sha256('bxyg34confirm|label-order|<root_id>'): a budget stop leaves an outcome-independent remainder
projection_basis: P20 wave k3 realization (5-25 dev slots per family): Dirichlet(counts + 1/2) uncertainty; the P22 point projection (K3 49.5, K4 41.4, repairable 90.9, 70,322 CPU-s) is reproduced as a median-type figure, not a guarantee

rules.adaptive_sampling: none: no look at labels or model outputs before the single evaluation
rules.collections: exactly one generation, one design freeze (catalogue + queries + sealed predictions before any teacher call), one labelling run, one evaluation
disjoint_from: BD_GEN_V1 and the 34 exposed test roots
rules.exclusion: no root is dropped for difficulty or failure; only registered missingness (Y0 unobserved) leaves a denominator
rules.replacement: none: a rejected slot stays rejected and is reported; slot composition never changes
rules.shortfall: realized n below the analysis lock's minimums -> the locked analysis still runs once and is labelled UNDERPOWERED; no extra wave

seeds: construction_seed = int(sha256-json([BXY_GEN_K34C, 'bxyg34confirm', 'c34', slot])[:8], 16); family id per slot (each root its own family)
